SELECT 
  CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) AS order_date_utc,
  COUNT(*) AS web_orders
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = '2025-11-28'
GROUP BY CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)
ORDER BY order_date_utc

SELECT 
  CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) AS order_date_utc,
  COUNT(*) AS web_orders
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = '2025-11-28'
  AND status <> 'cancelled'
GROUP BY CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)
ORDER BY order_date_utc
